verdict.rationale: Casium is a software platform (a client portal and case dashboard), so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence mentions a public repository, an open-source license, or any source availability. The probes show only absent llms.txt, markdown docs, and OpenAPI specs, which do not bear on source licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
